author: SickProdigy
description: Server-local prediction games with optional fictional Red Bank stakes and pari-mutuel payouts.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server prediction questions, outcomes, votes, creator IDs, server-local leaderboard scores, and—when optional Red Bank entries are enabled—member IDs, accepted entry amounts, settlement operations, and a bounded audit journal. It uses Red Bank to transfer fictional credits and does not store real-world payment or wallet data.
install_msg: Use `[p]predict` for the interactive home and `[p]predict start` for creation; use `[p]predictset bank` to review the optional fictional Red Bank integration. Bank stakes are disabled by default and have no real-world value.
name: Predictions
short: Prediction games with optional fictional Red Bank stakes.
